mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market slack, reducing corporate wage pressures and boosting near-term earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contracting below 100 during late-cycle economic conditions signals supply chain disruptions, temporarily boosting corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 during late-cycle economic conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP expansion above 23500 (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices near-term growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 shows quarterly expansion.

mechanism_narrative: CPI reading above 325 for two consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 325 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE decline) indicates a tight labor market, accelerating wage growth and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for three months) suppresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate investment slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has risen above 4.5% for three consecutive months.
